data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Atalya total 15, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.

in_greek.name: Atalya
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Goddess Atalanta
in_greek.long_meaning: Atalya είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Greek goddess Atalanta, whose name means 'she who brings forth'. In mythology, she is a huntress and virgin goddess. This name also appears in the Bible as the name of a woman in the Old Testament.

in_latin.name: Atalya
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Goddess Atalanta
in_latin.long_meaning: Atalya est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Greek goddess Atalanta, whose name means 'she who brings forth'. In mythology, she is a huntress and virgin goddess. This name also appears in the Bible as the name of a woman in the Old Testament.
